lemma x2611_16899_thm1_eq2_s1h1_aux1
    (n : ℕ) (b : Fin n → ℕ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i < j) (hb : b i < b j) :
    (∑ k : Fin n, k.val * (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j) k) <
      ∑ k : Fin n, k.val * b k := by
  classical
  have hne : i ≠ j := ne_of_lt hij
  let s := (Finset.univ.erase i).erase j
  have hsplit (f : Fin n → ℕ) :
      ∑ k, f k = (∑ k ∈ s, f k) + f j + f i := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
    rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (show j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i by simp [hne.symm])]
  rw [hsplit, hsplit]
  have hs : (∑ k ∈ s, k.val * (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j) k) =
      ∑ k ∈ s, k.val * b k := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    have hki : k ≠ i := by simpa [s] using (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).2).1
    have hkj : k ≠ j := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hk).1
    simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hki hkj]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_right, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  have hi : i.val < j.val := hij
  nlinarith

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_eq2_s1h1_aux2
    (n : ℕ) (Q : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop)
    (hbase : ∀ b, Antitone b → Q b)
    (hstep : ∀ b i j, j.val = i.val + 1 → b i < b j →
      Q (b ∘ Equiv.swap i j) → Q b) : ∀ b, Q b := by
  classical
  intro b
  induction b using (measure (fun b : Fin n → ℕ => ∑ i, i.val * b i)).wf.induction with
  | h b ih =>
    by_cases hb : Antitone b
    · exact hbase b hb
    · obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hbij⟩ :
          ∃ i j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + 1 ∧ b i < b j := by
        cases n with
        | zero => exact False.elim (hb (by intro i; exact Fin.elim0 i))
        | succ n =>
          rw [Fin.antitone_iff_succ_le] at hb
          push Not at hb
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hb
          exact ⟨i.castSucc, i.succ, rfl, hi⟩
      apply hstep b i j hij hbij
      apply ih
      exact x2611_16899_thm1_eq2_s1h1_aux1 n b i j (by change i.val < j.val; omega) hbij

lemma x2611_16899_thm1_eq2_s1h1_aux3
    {σ R : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    (τ : R) (i j : σ) (hij : i ≠ j) (f g : MvPolynomial σ R)

  have hne : (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [sub_eq_zero, MvPolynomial.X_injective.eq_iff] using hij
  have hdle : (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
    exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_sub _ _).trans (by simp)
  have hd : (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ R).totalDegree = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm hdle
    have hc : Finsupp.single i 1 ∈
        (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ R).support := by
      have hs : Finsupp.single j 1 ≠ (Finsupp.single i 1 : σ →₀ ℕ) := by
        intro he
        have he' := congrArg (fun a : σ →₀ ℕ => a i) he
        simp [hij] at he'
      simp [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, MvPolynomial.coeff_X, hs]
    simpa using MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hc
  have hr : (MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) f).totalDegree ≤ f.totalDegree :=
    MvPolynomial.totalDegree_rename_le _ _
  have hsub : (f - MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) f).totalDegree ≤ f.totalDegree :=
    (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_sub _ _).trans (max_le le_rfl hr)
  have hfirst : (MvPolynomial.C (1 - τ) * MvPolynomial.X j *
      (f - MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) f)).totalDegree ≤ 1 + f.totalDegree := by
    refine (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans ?_
    have hcx := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul (MvPolynomial.C (1 - τ)) (MvPolynomial.X j)
    simp only [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C, MvPolynomial.totalDegree_X, zero_add] at hcx
    omega
  have hsecond : (MvPolynomial.C τ * (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) *
      MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.swap i j) f).totalDegree ≤ 1 + f.totalDegree := by
    refine (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul _ _).trans ?_
    have hcx := MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul (MvPolynomial.C τ)
      (MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j)
    simp only [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_C, zero_add, hd] at hcx
    omega
  have hall : ((MvPolynomial.X i - MvPolynomial.X j) * g).totalDegree ≤
      1 + f.totalDegree := by
    rw [h]
    exact (MvPolynomial.totalDegree_add _ _).trans (max_le hfirst hsecond)
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · simp [hg]
  rw [MvPolynomial.totalDegree_mul_of_isDomain hne hg, hd] at hall
  omega
